The '''2020 Minnesota League Tournament 1''' (Bespin Season 2020 Tournament #1) was held on 1 February 2020 at Dreamers Vault in South Saint Paul, Minnesota, organized by [[Mark Walseth]]. 14 players played four constructed games and a final confrontation. Bryan M finished first.<ref name="mnl1">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=74390 2019 - 2020 MN League Tournament (#1)], forum.starwarsccg.org (13 January – 2 February 2020). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261105005126/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t74390.html Internet Archive]</ref>
